summary: SES S.A. furnished a Form 6-K attaching a September 29, 2026 press release announcing the pricing of EUR 500 million senior unsecured fixed-rate notes due 2031, a routine debt capital markets issuance rather than a special situation. The notes carry a 5.625% coupon, priced at 99.667% of nominal, with settlement scheduled October 6, 2026 and listing on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange Euro MTF. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes and refinance the EUR 500 million Guaranteed Notes due November 4, 2027, supporting deleveraging. BNP Paribas, ING, LBBW and Mizuho acted as Joint Global Coordinators; Goldman Sachs, Commerzbank, Intesa Sanpaolo and KBC were Joint Bookrunners. Rating agencies: Moody's Ba1 stable, Fitch BBB- stable. No equity special-situations angle; watch spread and refinancing execution.
